angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 647,001 km at 43.03 pc = 0.2 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 23.2381 +/- 0.0259 mas (same row, RUWE 0.98): 43.03 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.93 solar radii from Hord et al. 2024, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-5082.01 in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....167..233H/abstract): 647,001 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.99665 solar masses from Hord et al. 2024, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-5082.01 in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....167..233H/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5670 K from Hord et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-5082.01 in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....167..233H/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Hord et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-5082.01 in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....167..233H/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-5082.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.500, rounded to two decimals
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-5082 (pscomppars): [M/H] 0.09 dex, from TICv8 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158..138S/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-5082 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.08961, from TICv8 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158..138S/abstract)
ageSource: Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 3368214650329888512, flags_flame 00: age_flame 10.406918 Gyr (16th to 84th percentiles 8.97696 to 11.813708)
rotationPeriodSource: VizieR J/A+A/661/A24/table3 (Corona-chromosphere connection), column Protcomp: 7.837 d, the row 0.0 arcsec from the star's J2000 place. The middle of 3 catalogued periods, 2 of them within 20% of it
